label: Updated isolated debug app, empty store, no provider connected, no folder or editor, tour dismissed, visible window
cpuConvention: 100% = one logical core; Mach ticks converted with mach_timebase_info
limits: Sampled physical footprint, not an allocation trace or exclusive system-wide memory cost.
Short-lived processes between samples and counters before a process first appears are excluded.
Disk counters describe physical I/O, not all cached filesystem reads. GPU watts and network bytes are not measured.
An external local model server may not be attributed to the app and must be measured separately.
scenarioValidation: Initial native test window had an incomplete/stale paint; raising and resizing revealed the complete composer. Retained for transparency, excluded from the representative idle result.
